question: Which country won the 2018 FIH Men's Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __Belgium.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 2018 Men's Hockey World Cup was held in Odisha, India.
 
• It was the 14th edition of the Hockey World Cup.
 
• Belgium was the winner.
 
• Belgium defeated the Netherlands in the final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The 2023 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup will take place in Odisha, India.
 
• Hockey:
 
 
• The Hockey World cup is organized by the International Hockey Federation (FIH) once in four years.
 
• The headquarters of FIH is located in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• "Blackheath Rugby and Hockey Club" was the first hockey club in the world that was set up in the year 1861 in England.
 
• The first Hockey World Cup was organized in Barcelona (Spain) in 1971 and the winner was Pakistan.
 
• India took part in Olympics for the first time in the year 1928 (in Amsterdam Olympics).
 
• In Olympics, India has won the hockey title a maximum of eight times.
 
 
 
• ​Terminologies associated with Hockey are:
